verdict.rationale: Sprinto is a compliance SaaS with a developer API, so a sandbox or test environment is a fair axis to ask about. The evidence pack documents no sandbox, test tenant, or dry-run mode. The only testing surface, the API Playground, explicitly runs requests against the live tenant, which is the opposite of isolation from production data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
